'''Tartu Jalgpallikool Tammeka''', commonly known as '''Tartu Tammeka''' or simply '''Tammeka''', is an Estonian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Tartu]] that competes in [[Meistriliiga]], the top flight of [[Estonian football league system|Estonian football]]. The club's home ground is [[Tamme Stadium]].

Founded in 1989, Tammeka are the biggest football club in southern Estonia with over 700 members.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-06 |title=Galerii ⟩ Tammeka tutvustas esindusvõistkondi, aga ka tulevikuplaane |url=https://tartu.postimees.ee/7973917/galerii-tammeka-tutvustas-esindusvoistkondi-aga-ka-tulevikuplaane |access-date= |website=Tartu Postimees |language=et}}</ref> The club has played in the Meistriliiga since the [[2005 Meistriliiga|2005 season]] and have never been relegated from the Estonian top division."}}
